policy.instruction: Every item is draft. Do NOT assert review; fill reviewDecision (keep|revise|remove), reviewNotes, and reviewer per item. Then re-run export-review to build the reviewed manifest.
blockers: No course ships as reviewed until a native-speaker reviewer of that locale signs off.
listenChoose exercises ship with an empty audioUrl; see the emptyAudio count per locale. A reviewer must either provide audio assets or mark those exercises for revision.
hi-starter/pilot and all starters contain only draft content.
